name: DINWEYS Battery Master Data
description: Single source of truth for DINWEYS heavy-duty truck starting battery specifications across JIS, DIN and BCI standards. Manufacturer: Chengguang Power Tech Co., Ltd.

dataProvenance.method: First-party manufacturer specification (DINWEYS datasheet and published product pages), cross-referenced against independent industry fitment guides and third-party battery catalogs where available.
dataProvenance.verificationPolicy: Fields not published by the manufacturer are left null and marked 'unverified'. Third-party catalog/industry reference specifications are marked 'reference' and always carry source + source_url. Ratings are never interpolated or assumed. Specifications vary by manufacturer — always confirm against the specific vehicle.

sourceTiers.tier1: Manufacturer datasheet, standards organizations (JIS D5301, EN 50342-1, SAE J537)
sourceTiers.tier2: Independent commercial-vehicle fitment guides (Club Assist, Century Batteries)
sourceTiers.tier3: Third-party battery catalogs (Bosch, Yuasa, SSB, Powsea)

fieldDefinitions.case_size: Case-size designation used for tray fitment
fieldDefinitions.cca_standard: Standard the CCA rating is measured to
fieldDefinitions.rc_standard: Standard the reserve capacity is measured to
fieldDefinitions.weight_kg: Battery weight in kg (null = not published by manufacturer)
fieldDefinitions.truck_brand: Truck brands commonly using this size (reference only)
fieldDefinitions.verification_status: confirmed_first_party | reference | unverified | on_request (reference = third-party catalog/industry source, not DINWEYS first-party)

models.source: Third-party reference: BRAVA N70 (65D31R) datasheet, Western Battery N70, BCI Group Sizes (Group 27 = 65D31R)
models.notes: Third-party reference — NOT a DINWEYS published stock rating. models.application: Largest heavy-duty trucks, cold-climate starting, prime diesel generators
models.country: China (manufactured); primary markets Asia, Middle East, Africa
models.source: Third-party reference: UPLUS JIS catalog (245H52R = N220), Powsea 245H52
models.notes: Third-party reference — NOT a DINWEYS published stock rating. UPLUS lists 245H52 (N220) at 220Ah (C20), RC 456 min, CCA 1200A, 515×265×216mm (total height 254mm) — a capacity/CCA step above N200 (190H52). Powsea also lists 245H52 as 12V 220Ah. Confirm tray and rating before replacement.
